quote_method: Historical.metadata.get_cost with exact dataset/schema/symbols/time bounds. Metadata and symbology are free according to official docs. No timeseries.get_range or batch.submit_job before explicit approval.
symbol_rule: Parent includes all outright maturities. For narrower contract windows resolve exchange instrument definitions/IDs first; never assume Barchart two-digit contract names equal vendor raw_symbol.
credit: Official advertised new-team credit $125, once per team, expires after six months. Actual account eligibility/balance not checked. Never treat credit as guaranteed coverage.
quote_required_fields: rights to research and public aggregated results
bridge_audit: Before changing vendor use ONLY consumed 2025 contract overlap: timestamp conventions, missing bars, OHLC quarter ticks, volume totals and RVOL-input parity, definitions/expiration. Do not choose vendor based on future strategy returns.
bar_limitations: OHLCV-1m has no trade count/ticks, bid/ask, aggressor, queue or intrabar ordering. No synthetic tick counts or claimed exact fills. Separate trades/TBBO quote only if explicitly needed later.
